title: Fear-consumed mobs: Yellow construct armour and tools
desc: J: "things consumed by fear need better light construct armor and tools nearly like mine". A zombie villager in four Yellow construct armour sets (Y1 scales, Y2 lightning, Y3 dread, a mix) and holding 3D construct swords, axes, picks and bows (three each, the three Yellow looks spread across them), rougher and crueller than J's own gear. Each mob walks in and swings, lunges or shoots once; the lineup shows every take side by side.

takes.name: Y1 scales: Scale Reaver
takes.facts: Y1 scales; pointed scale rows (lower rows further out), saw-edged tiered pauldrons with spikes, saw-brow helm with five swept crown spikes, nose guard, scale tassets, knee spikes, clawed boots; walks in (1-46), lunges and grabs (hit 59)

takes.name: Y2 lightning: Storm-split
takes.facts: Y2 lightning; breastplate split by a glowing lightning gap, halves uneven, branching cracks; one huge bolt-finned pauldron, one small; wedge helm, chevron slit, zigzag bolt horns; uneven blade tassets, finned greaves, wedge boots; walks in (1-46), lunges and grabs (hit 59)

takes.name: Y3 dread: Hollow Dread
takes.facts: Y3 dread; ribcage bars over the robe, a three-layer saw-topped cowl rising behind the head, drooping hooked pauldrons, long curved claws, hooded helm with a hollow face and fangs, ragged strip tassets, heel spurs; walks in (1-46), lunges and grabs (hit 59)

takes.name: Mix: Fear Knight
takes.facts: Y1+Y2+Y3 mix; Y3 breastplate and great helm, Y2 boss spike and spiked gorget ring, Y1 scale waist, pauldron tiers, crest and tassets, Y2 pauldron horns and knee spikes, cracks; walks in (1-46), lunges and grabs (hit 59)

takes.name: Sword, Y1: barbed saw-back
takes.facts: Y1 scales; straight blade, barbed saw back, hooked guard, scale-cut ricasso, dark core, lit cutting edge; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Sword, Y2: lightning blade
takes.facts: Y2 lightning; zigzag blade in offset sections, forked tip, cracks, one-sided spike guard; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Sword, Y3: dread falchion
takes.facts: Y3 dread; blade widening to a clipped point, back hook, claw guard curling over the hand; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Axe, Y2: saw-bearded
takes.facts: Y2 lightning; bearded bit with a sawtooth edge, back spike, top spike, zigzag crack; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Axe, Y3: crescent hook
takes.facts: Y3 dread; big crescent bit with hooked horns, back hook, ribbed haft; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Axe, Y1: scale cleaver
takes.facts: Y1 scales; three overlapping scale plates stepping out to the edge, cleaver back, spiked butt; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Pick, Y3: drooping horn
takes.facts: Y3 dread; long front spike curving down, short spiked hammer back, collar ribs; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Pick, Y1: spike and adze
takes.facts: Y1 scales; front spike, back adze blade, scale collar plates; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Pick, Y2: split bolt
takes.facts: Y2 lightning; split twin head with a glowing gap, zigzag bolt prongs front and back; walks in (1-46), winds up with a short charge (54-57), cuts edge-first (hit 60), recovers

takes.name: Bow, Y1: scale compound
takes.facts: Y1 scales; swept riser of stacked scale plates, saw-edged split limbs, twin cams, sight pin, stabiliser; walks in (1-46), turns and draws (52-60), looses at 64, arrow flies

takes.name: Bow, Y2: bolt compound
takes.facts: Y2 lightning; zigzag bolt riser and limbs with lit edges, star cams, long stabiliser with bolt fins; walks in (1-46), turns and draws (52-60), looses at 64, arrow flies

takes.name: Bow, Y3: hooked dread bow
takes.facts: Y3 dread; hollow ribbed riser (two rails, rib bars), hooked limbs with claws, thorn stabiliser; walks in (1-46), turns and draws (52-60), looses at 64, arrow flies

takes.name: Lineup: every take side by side
takes.facts: static copies, orthographic, three tiers: A1-A4; S1-S3, X1-X3; P1-P3, B1-B3
